verdict.rationale: Square documents a Catalog API for designing item catalogs and an Inventory API for tracking stock, and its merchant site advertises inventory tracking, which covers the core of managing items with inventory counts. Multi-location support is also documented, but the evidence consists mostly of page titles. Cross-register and cross-channel sync is implied by the shared platform rather than stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that inventory counts sync in real time across registers and online/offline channels, detailed documentation content beyond titles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
